title: Hip hop Sensation G Smoove drops recent single "Hustlers Prayers" Feat. P Garci
htmlContent:
Hailing from Boston, G Smoove is a multi-talented rapper and songwriter currently making waves with his recent track, "Hustlers Prayer." G Smoove came together with P Garci to create this world-class sound.

G Smoove's "Hustlers Prayer" Feat. P Garci is a genuinely mega record as the music shoots for the stars and excels in every way possible. The production is impressive and vocally perfect, and the writing takes this song to the moon to make it a record you can't live without. G Smoove has created a Massive catalog that has been growing him an excellent-sized fanbase.
